# Fictional Tenancy Act, chapter 2

Section 2.1. The landlord must give notice of a rent increase at least 60 days before it takes effect.

Section 2.2. A rent increase may not exceed 5 percent of the current rent within twelve months.

Section 2.3. If the rent is paid more than 10 days late, the landlord may send a written warning. If the rent is more than 30 days late, the landlord may terminate the lease, unless the tenant is a pensioner.

Section 2.4. The deposit may not exceed 3 months rent.

Section 2.5. For each full week of delay a late fee of 2 percent of the monthly rent is charged, but at most 10 percent of the monthly rent.

The notice period of rent increases is 60 days.
